excerpt.zh: 我方特工正在试图同其他叛乱团体和政府的线人接头，分享我们推翻帝国政权的共同目标。
excerpt.en: Our operatives are attempting to link up with other rebel groups and governments that share our goal of overthrowing the Imperium.

texts.zh: 我方特工正在试图同其他叛乱团体和政府的线人接头，分享我们推翻帝国政权的共同目标。
texts.en: Our operatives are attempting to link up with other rebel groups and governments that share our goal of overthrowing the Imperium.

texts.zh: 星海帝国现已成功地撑过了席卷全境的暴乱风波！随着帝国重掌权威，公开叛乱的可能已经微乎其微。我们可以撤回特工了。
texts.en: The Imperium has somehow managed to weather the storm of turmoil and instability that was only recently sweeping across it! With Imperial authorities now firmly back in control, conditions are no longer favorable for an open revolt. Our operatives have been withdrawn.

label.zh: 我们现在应当等待时机……
label.en: We shall bide our time for now...

tooltips.zh: 这项行动因为帝国权威上升超过80而失败
tooltips.en: The operation failed due to Imperial Authority rising above 80.

texts.zh: 有关我们即将掀起叛乱的消息必须严密保守，不能让帝国及其麾下特工知道，越久越好。帝国的反谍报线人在整个星系范围内都成了被针对的目标。
texts.en: Knowledge of our impending rebellion must be kept from the Imperium and its agents for as long as possible. Imperial counterespionage assets are being aggressively targeted throughout the galaxy.

texts.zh: 有关我们即将掀起叛乱的消息必须严密保守，不能让帝国及其麾下特工知道，越久越好。帝国安全总局的反谍报线人在整个星系范围内都成了被主动针对的目标。
texts.en: Knowledge of our impending rebellion must be kept from the Imperium and its agents for as long as possible. Assets of the Imperial Security Directorate are being aggressively targeted throughout the galaxy.

texts.zh: 星海帝国现已成功地撑过了席卷全境的暴乱风波！随着帝国重掌权威，公开叛乱的可能已经微乎其微。我们可以撤回特工了。

label.en: We shall bide our time for now...

tooltips.zh: 这项行动因为帝国权威上升超过80而失败
tooltips.en: The operation failed due to Imperial Authority rising above 80.

texts.zh: 帝制派和[target.GetRulerTitle]的其他宵小之辈在每一个帝国成员国境内都占据着数量上的优势。线人在叛乱爆发的时候必须就位，一旦行动，就要控制住、亦或是直接抹除掉这些帝制派分子。
texts.en: Imperial loyalists and other lackeys of the [target.GetRulerTitle] are present in great numbers in each of the Imperium's member states. Assets need to be in place to immediately seize or otherwise neutralize these loyalists the moment the rebellion breaks out.

texts.zh: 星海帝国现已成功地撑过了席卷全境的暴乱风波！随着帝国重掌权威，公开叛乱的可能已经微乎其微。我们可以撤回特工了。
texts.en: The Imperium has somehow managed to weather the storm of turmoil and instability that was only recently sweeping across it! With Imperial authorities now firmly back in control, conditions are no longer favorable for an open revolt. Our operatives have been withdrawn.

label.en: We shall bide our time for now...

tooltips.zh: 这项行动因为帝国权威上升超过80而失败
tooltips.en: The operation failed due to Imperial Authority rising above 80.

texts.zh: 一切都已就绪。特工已经出现在了帝国的每一个成员国境内，同当地对起义行动表示同情的势力相互协作。剩下的就看，当帷幕拉开的时候，他们是否能够说动政府支持我们的事业。
texts.en: Everything is nearly in place. Operatives are present in every member state of the Imperium, coordinating with whatever local elements are sympathetic to the rebel movement. It remains to be seen whether they can sway their governments to support our cause when push comes to shove.

texts.zh: 星海帝国现已成功地撑过了席卷全境的暴乱风波！随着帝国重掌权威，公开叛乱的可能已经微乎其微。我们可以撤回特工了。
texts.en: The Imperium has somehow managed to weather the storm of turmoil and instability that was only recently sweeping across it! With Imperial authorities now firmly back in control, conditions are no longer favorable for an open revolt. Our operatives have been withdrawn.

label.en: We shall bide our time for now...

tooltips.zh: 这项行动因为帝国权威上升超过80而失败
tooltips.en: The operation failed due to Imperial Authority rising above 80.

texts.zh: 是时候了。暗藏在整个星系各处的特工都在等待密码指令，并根据指令行动。星海帝国的落幕之战就从此时奏响。
texts.en: It is time. Concealed operatives all over the galaxy are waiting for the code phrase that will send them into action. This is the beginning of the end of the Galactic Imperium.

texts.zh: 星海帝国现已成功地撑过了席卷全境的暴乱风波！随着帝国重掌权威，公开叛乱的可能已经微乎其微。我们可以撤回特工了。
texts.en: The Imperium has somehow managed to weather the storm of turmoil and instability that was only recently sweeping across it! With Imperial authorities now firmly back in control, conditions are no longer favorable for an open revolt. Our operatives have been withdrawn.

texts.zh:
我们正处于一个至关重要的时刻——星海帝国已经四面楚歌，濒临全面叛乱。也许再也不会有这么好的推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的机会了！现在，帝国中起义的成员正团结到一个统一联邦的旗帜之下。

由于[Root.GetName]在这场盛大的叛乱中打响了第一枪，各界纷纷请求我们在接下来的战争中领导这个伟大的联盟，毫无疑问这也是星系的一份。
texts.en:
We have reached a pivotal moment - the Galactic Imperium is hovering on the brink of open revolt. There may never be a better time to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]! Even now, the rebelling members of the Imperium are uniting under the banner of a single federation.

As it was the [Root.GetName] that orchestrated the opening shots of the rebellion, we have been asked to lead this great alliance in the upcoming war, which will no doubt be of galactic proportions.

label.en: Freedom will be restored to the galaxy!

tooltips.zh:
繁星之乱：
我们会加入义军联邦，并向[gal_emperor.GetName]及帝制派联邦宣战。
tooltips.en:
Galactic Rebellion:
We will join a Rebel Federation at war with the [gal_emperor.GetName] and their Loyalist Federation.

texts.zh:
星海帝国被卷入了内战！它的成员们分成了两派，其中义军意图推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]，而帝制派则为了延续帝国而战。

我们的宗主[From.GetName]选择加入帝制派，因此我们别无选择只能一同加入！
texts.en:
The Galactic Imperium has been engulfed in civil war! Its members have divided into rebels, who seek to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], and loyalists, who fight to preserve the Imperium.

As our Overlord, the [From.GetName], has sided with the Loyalists, we have no choice but to join them as well!

texts.zh:
星海帝国被卷入了内战！它的成员们分成了两派，其中义军意图推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]，而帝制派则为了延续帝国而战。

我们的宗主[From.GetName]选择加入义军，因此我们别无选择只能一同加入！
texts.en:
The Galactic Imperium has been engulfed in civil war! Its members have divided into rebels, who seek to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], and loyalists, who fight to preserve the Imperium.

As our Overlord, the [From.GetName], has sided with the Rebels, we have no choice but to join them as well!

texts.zh:
星海帝国被卷入了内战！它的成员们分成了两派，其中义军意图推翻[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]，而帝制派则为了延续帝国而战。

由于我们是[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的直接附属国，因此我们根本没有选择的余地，只能成为帝制派。
texts.en:
The Galactic Imperium has been engulfed in civil war! Its members have divided into rebels, who seek to overthrow the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], and loyalists, who fight to preserve the Imperium.

As we are a direct subject of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], we have little choice in the matter - we have sided with the Loyalists.

texts.zh:
我们正处于一个至关重要的时刻——星海帝国已经已经四面楚歌，濒临全面叛乱。现在，帝国中起义的成员正团结到一个由[rebel_leader.GetName]领导的统一联邦的旗帜之下。同时，[gal_emperor.GetName]则正召集忠诚且坚毅者不惜一切代价捍卫帝国。

内战之火即将席卷全星系，而两边都在拉拢我们的加入。我们应当与谁并肩作战？
texts.en:
We have reached a pivotal moment - the Galactic Imperium is hovering on the brink of open revolt. Even now, the rebelling members of the Imperium, led by the [rebel_leader.GetName], are uniting under the banner of a single federation. Meanwhile, the [gal_emperor.GetName] is gathering loyalists determined to preserve the Imperium at any cost.

Civil war is about to engulf the galaxy, and both sides have asked for our allegiance. Who shall we stand with?

tooltips.zh: 我们同义军并肩作战，反抗帝制派。
tooltips.en: We side with the Rebels in their struggle against the Imperial Loyalists.

tooltips.zh: 我们同帝制派并肩作战，试图粉碎叛乱。
tooltips.en: We side with the Imperial Loyalists in their attempt to crush the Rebels.

texts.zh:
叛军利用了星海帝国当前的弱势，发动了一场挑战我们统治的公开叛乱！

他们煽动叛乱的企图碰了一鼻子灰，只有[From.GetName]的叛徒们站在了叛乱的一方。其他的帝国成员坚定不移地效忠于他们的[Root.GetRulerTitle]。在忠实伙伴的帮助下，我们很快可以了结这场微不足道的叛变。

乱党威胁要颠覆我们建立的新秩序，这是我们一直辛苦斗争取得的成果。不能再犹豫了，这样的行为一定出重拳，唯有如此这片星系才能恢复和平。

为了星海帝国的上善之耀！
texts.en:
Insurgents are taking advantage of the present weakness of the Galactic Imperium to launch an open revolt against our rule!

Their attempts to foment rebellion have largely met with failure, however - only the traitors of the [From.GetName] have sided with the rebels. The other members of the Imperium stand firmly with their [Root.GetRulerTitle]. With the aid of our loyalist friends, we must bring a swift end to this pathetic revolt.

This rebellion threatens to undo the New Order that we have fought so hard to establish. It must be dealt with swiftly and decisively, so that peace can be restored to the galaxy.

For the greater glory of the Galactic Imperium!

texts.zh:
叛军利用了星海帝国当前的弱势，发动了一场挑战我们统治的公开叛乱！

叛党们以[From.Root.GetAllianceName]的名义集结部队，并且有报道称，他们针对控制区域内的帝国官员进行了大量的抓捕活动。

乱党威胁要颠覆我们建立的新秩序，这是我们一直辛苦斗争取得的成果。不能再犹豫了，这样的行为一定出重拳，唯有如此这片星系才能恢复和平。

为了星海帝国的上善之耀！
texts.en:
Insurgents are taking advantage of the present weakness of the Galactic Imperium to launch an open revolt against our rule!

The traitors are marshalling their forces under the banner of the [From.Root.GetAllianceName], and there are reports of mass arrests targeting Imperial officials within their territory.

This rebellion threatens to undo the New Order that we have fought so hard to establish. It must be dealt with swiftly and decisively, so that peace can be restored to the galaxy.

For the greater glory of the Galactic Imperium!

texts.zh:
叛军利用了星海帝国当前的弱势，发动了一场挑战我们统治的公开叛乱！

帝国的臣属被谎言和宣传所动摇，站到了叛乱的一方。这种前所未有的背叛使得[Root.GetName]必须独自为守卫星系的稳定和秩序而战。我们一定不能使[Root.GetRulerTitle]蒙羞。

乱党威胁要颠覆我们建立的新秩序，这是我们一直辛苦斗争取得的成果。不能再犹豫了，这样的行为一定出重拳，唯有如此这片星系才能恢复和平。

为了星海帝国的上善之耀！
texts.en:
Insurgents are taking advantage of the present weakness of the Galactic Imperium to launch an open revolt against our rule!

Swayed by lies and propaganda, the subject nations of the Imperium have sided with the rebels. This unprecedented betrayal has left the [Root.GetName] standing alone in the defense of order and stability in the galaxy. We must not fail the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

This rebellion threatens to undo the New Order that we have fought so hard to establish. It must be dealt with swiftly and decisively, so that peace can be restored to the galaxy.

For the greater glory of the Galactic Imperium!

label.zh: 这些叛军必须为他们的傲慢无礼付出代价。
label.en: These rebels must pay for their insolence.

texts.zh: 星海帝国被卷入了内战！若干成员站起来反抗[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的统治，他们以[rebel_leader.GetAllianceName]的名义团结一致。而由[gal_emperor.GetName]领导的帝制派则还以颜色，并且誓要保卫帝国对星系的掌控。
texts.en: The Galactic Imperium has been engulfed in civil war! Several members have rebelled against the authority of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle], gathering under the banner of the [rebel_leader.GetAllianceName]. Loyalists, led by the [gal_emperor.GetName], have struck back and are determined to preserve the Imperium's hold over the galaxy.

texts.zh: 星海帝国被卷入了内战！[rebel_leader.GetName]正在发动反抗[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]统治的起义。而由[gal_emperor.GetName]领导的帝制派则还以颜色，并且誓要保卫帝国对星系的掌控。
texts.en: The Galactic Imperium has been engulfed in civil war! The [rebel_leader.GetName] is rebelling against the authority of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]. Loyalists, led by the [gal_emperor.GetName], have struck back and are determined to preserve the Imperium's hold over the galaxy.

texts.zh:
这是至暗时刻。[gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle]的腐化影响范围远超我们的想象，帝国中的其他成员没有一位敢于加入我们的公开起义！

我们现在将独自对抗星海帝国的联合军队，因为后者已经因战争进行了动员。
texts.en:
These are dark times. The corrupting influence of the [gal_emperor.GetRulerTitle] extends much further than we thought - none of the other members of the Imperium have had the courage to join us in open revolt!

We now stand alone against the combined might of the Galactic Imperium as it mobilizes for war.
